day-82-act-01.title: Evaluation Pre-Registration: Fixed Task Suites, Baselines, and Declared Hypotheses
day-82-act-01.prerequisites: Day 81 agent-assisted delivery practice and the ticket-23 evidence contract files.
day-82-act-01.objective: Design a pre-registered evaluation protocol that fixes the task suite, the baseline agent, falsifiable hypotheses, and stop conditions before any measured run, following the structure of live_eval_contract.json.
day-82-act-01.instructions:
Study source: within this activity's existing reading/practice time, use Demystifying evals for AI agents, The structure of an evaluation: task, trial, grader, transcript, outcome, harness and suite, then explain one connection to the local task in your own words. Keep the local exercise and acceptance checks; use its original explanation if the external source is unavailable. 1. Read projects/agent_learning/evidence/live_eval_contract.json and report.en.md; note status blocked-awaiting-authorization.
2. Fix the task suite: enumerate the six contract tasks (live-summarize-notes-success, live-invalid-arguments-recovery, live-unknown-tool-request, live-missing-note-failure, live-step-budget-exhaustion, live-termination-honesty), each with its deterministic_analog fixture task.
3. Declare the baseline: the deterministic-v1 fixture run is the baseline; the live model is the unevaluated candidate. No live claim exists until authorization is recorded.
4. Pre-register falsifiable hypotheses (e.g., 'candidate completes live-summarize-notes-success with report SHA-256 equal to the fixture expectation') and explicit stop conditions (authorization gate fails → no live run).
5. Commit the protocol to eval_protocol.md before any execution; date every later amendment.
day-82-act-01.exercise_prompt: Author eval_protocol.md fixing the six-task suite, the deterministic-v1 baseline, two falsifiable hypotheses, and the authorization stop condition.
day-82-act-01.hint: Copy the six task_ids verbatim from live_eval_contract.json; write each hypothesis as a metric assertion that could fail.
day-82-act-01.mastery_criterion: Produce a pre-registered protocol whose metrics are checkable independently of the agent's own narrative.

day-82-act-02.title: Metric Specification: Task Outcome, Tool Correctness, Budgets, and Termination Honesty
day-82-act-02.objective: Specify the four contract metric families — outcome_passed, tool_behavior_passed, budget_passed, failure_handling_passed — so each is verifiable from recorded action/observation evidence rather than self-report or hidden chain-of-thought.
day-82-act-02.instructions:
1. For each metric, write a one-line definition, the observable evidence it consumes, and its pass rule.
2. outcome_passed: report.txt content equals the fixture expectation (SHA-256 recorded in the contract).
3. tool_behavior_passed: every recorded action name is in allowed_tools and every arguments payload is a JSON object.
4. budget_passed: declared step and retry ceilings are never exceeded.
5. failure_handling_passed: every failed observation carries a structured error value and the termination reason is honest.
6. Add per-task baseline comparison and measured cost fields; mark every live_value null until an authorized run fills it.
day-82-act-02.exercise_prompt: Write metric_spec.json containing definitions, observable evidence, and pass rules for all four metric families plus the baseline-comparison rule.
day-82-act-02.hint: Each definition must name a recorded artifact (trace entry, report file, counter) a third party could recompute.
day-82-act-02.mastery_criterion: Define metrics a third party can recompute from traces without trusting the agent.

day-82-act-03.title: Recomputing the Deterministic-v1 Baseline from Actual Artifacts
day-82-act-03.objective: Re-execute the deterministic fixture baseline, reconcile its recorded metrics against the contract, and treat every live_results field as null because the evaluation is blocked-awaiting-authorization.
day-82-act-03.instructions:
1. Run python -m projects.agent_learning.cli evaluate --fixture summarize-notes --output <scratch-output-path> and inspect the produced report and trace.
2. Run python -m unittest discover -s tests/projects -p 'test_agent_learning.py' to confirm the deterministic suite is green.
3. Run python projects/agent_learning/evidence/validate_contract.py; confirm it passes, and confirm --require-authorized still fails by design.
4. Copy the baseline metrics into your ledger: outcome_passed=1, tool_behavior_passed=1, budget_passed=1, failure_handling_passed=1 over the deterministic task.
5. Record expected_report_sha256 provenance; write live_value=null for every metric — null means unavailable, never zero.
day-82-act-03.exercise_prompt: Produce baseline_ledger.json containing the four recomputed deterministic metrics, the reproduction command you ran, and explicit null live_value fields.
day-82-act-03.hint: The baseline_metrics block inside live_eval_contract.json lists the expected values; your ledger must match them.
day-82-act-03.mastery_criterion: Recompute and cite deterministic baseline evidence while keeping live values explicitly null.

day-82-act-04.title: Assessment: Registered Evaluation Protocol Document
day-82-act-04.objective: Deliver a complete protocol document covering the fixed task suite, baselines, metric definitions, a confounder register, and the live authorization gate status.
day-82-act-04.instructions:
1. Assemble protocol.md containing: task suite with deterministic analogs, baseline metrics you recomputed, metric definitions, falsifiable hypotheses, stop conditions, and the blocked-awaiting-authorization gate.
2. Add a confounder register seed listing model id, pinned revision, decoding configuration, tool schema versions, and retry policy as variables to freeze later.
3. Verify every claim cites an artifact path or a metric you personally recomputed; remove anything asserted without evidence.
4. Attach source and version records for AgentBench, SWE-bench, tau-bench, WebArena, and the OpenAI evals repository used in this day's source cards.
day-82-act-04.exercise_prompt: Submit protocol.md passing the rubric: fixed tasks, reproduced deterministic baseline, falsifiable hypotheses, null live values, and a recorded authorization gate state.
day-82-act-04.hint: A protocol with no falsifiable statement is a wish list, not an evaluation.
day-82-act-04.answer:
assert protocol.tasks_fixed == 6
assert protocol.baseline_metrics == {'outcome_passed':1,'tool_behavior_passed':1,'budget_passed':1,'failure_handling_passed':1}
assert protocol.live_status == 'blocked-awaiting-authorization'
assert all(v is None for v in protocol.live_values.values())
day-82-act-04.mastery_criterion: Independently deliver an evaluable protocol — not a summary of someone else's run.
